question: How many customers belong to each market segment? Return the segment and the customer count.
gold_sql: SELECT C_MKTSEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY C_MKTSEGMENT ORDER BY C_MKTSEGMENT

question: What is the average account balance of customers in each market segment? Return the segment and the average balance.
gold_sql: SELECT C_MKTSEGMENT, AVG(C_ACCTBAL) AS AVG_BALANCE FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY C_MKTSEGMENT ORDER BY C_MKTSEGMENT

question: What is the total value of all orders in each status? Return the order status and the total value.
gold_sql: SELECT O_ORDERSTATUS, SUM(O_TOTALPRICE) AS TOTAL_VALUE FROM ORDERS GROUP BY O_ORDERSTATUS ORDER BY O_ORDERSTATUS

question: How many orders fall into each priority level? Return the priority level and the order count.
gold_sql: SELECT O_ORDERPRIORITY, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM ORDERS GROUP BY O_ORDERPRIORITY ORDER BY O_ORDERPRIORITY

question: Which ten suppliers have the lowest account balance? Return the supplier name and the account balance, lowest first.
gold_sql: SELECT S_NAME, S_ACCTBAL FROM SUPPLIER ORDER BY S_ACCTBAL ASC, S_SUPPKEY ASC LIMIT 10

question: What are the total, average, minimum, and maximum quantities across all line items? Return those four values in a single row.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(L_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY, AVG(L_QUANTITY) AS AVG_QTY, MIN(L_QUANTITY) AS MIN_QTY, MAX(L_QUANTITY) AS MAX_QTY FROM LINEITEM

question: How many parts does each manufacturer produce? Return the manufacturer and the part count.
gold_sql: SELECT P_MFGR, COUNT(*) AS PART_COUNT FROM PART GROUP BY P_MFGR ORDER BY P_MFGR

question: What is the total revenue for each return-flag category? Return the return flag and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT L_RETURNFLAG, SUM(L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM GROUP BY L_RETURNFLAG ORDER BY L_RETURNFLAG

question: How much revenue was generated in each year, based on ship date? Return the year and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) AS SHIP_YEAR, SUM(L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM GROUP BY YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) ORDER BY SHIP_YEAR

question: How many orders were placed in each quarter of 1996? Return the quarter number and the order count.
gold_sql: SELECT QUARTER(O_ORDERDATE) AS QUARTER, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE YEAR(O_ORDERDATE) = 1996 GROUP BY QUARTER(O_ORDERDATE) ORDER BY QUARTER

question: Which five customers spent the most in total across all their orders? Return the customer name and the amount spent, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT C.C_NAME, SUM(O.O_TOTALPRICE) AS TOTAL_SPENT FROM CUSTOMER C JOIN ORDERS O ON C.C_CUSTKEY = O.O_CUSTKEY GROUP BY C.C_CUSTKEY, C.C_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_SPENT DESC, C.C_CUSTKEY ASC LIMIT 5

question: How many suppliers are based in each nation? Return the nation name and the supplier count.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, COUNT(*) AS SUPPLIER_COUNT FROM SUPPLIER S JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY N.N_NAME

question: What is the average order value for each customer market segment? Return the segment and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT C.C_MKTSEGMENT, AVG(O.O_TOTALPRICE) AS AVG_ORDER_VALUE FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY GROUP BY C.C_MKTSEGMENT ORDER BY C.C_MKTSEGMENT

question: How many line items were shipped in each month of 1997? Return the month number and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(L_SHIPDATE) AS SHIP_MONTH, COUNT(*) AS LINEITEM_COUNT FROM LINEITEM WHERE YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) = 1997 GROUP BY MONTH(L_SHIPDATE) ORDER BY SHIP_MONTH

question: Which three customers placed the most orders? Return the customer name and the order count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT C.C_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM CUSTOMER C JOIN ORDERS O ON C.C_CUSTKEY = O.O_CUSTKEY GROUP BY C.C_CUSTKEY, C.C_NAME ORDER BY ORDER_COUNT DESC, C.C_CUSTKEY ASC LIMIT 3

question: What percentage of line items were shipped late each year? Return the year and the late-shipment percentage.
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) AS SHIP_YEAR, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN L_SHIPDATE > L_COMMITDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS LATE_SHIPMENT_PCT FROM LINEITEM GROUP BY YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) ORDER BY SHIP_YEAR

question: What is the total quantity ordered for each part brand? Return the brand and the total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT P.P_BRAND, SUM(L.L_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_QTY FROM LINEITEM L JOIN PART P ON L.L_PARTKEY = P.P_PARTKEY GROUP BY P.P_BRAND ORDER BY P.P_BRAND

question: Which five parts generated the most revenue? Return the part name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT P.P_NAME, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN PART P ON L.L_PARTKEY = P.P_PARTKEY GROUP BY P.P_PARTKEY, P.P_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC, P.P_PARTKEY ASC LIMIT 5

question: What was the revenue for each ship mode during 1995? Return the ship mode and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT L_SHIPMODE, SUM(L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM WHERE YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) = 1995 GROUP BY L_SHIPMODE ORDER BY L_SHIPMODE

question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order in each year? Return the year and the customer count.
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(O_ORDERDATE) AS ORDER_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT O_CUSTKEY) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT FROM ORDERS GROUP BY YEAR(O_ORDERDATE) ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR

question: Which five nations have the most customers? Return the nation name and the customer count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT FROM CUSTOMER C JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY CUSTOMER_COUNT DESC, N.N_NAME ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average discount applied to line items shipped in each year? Return the year and the average discount.
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) AS SHIP_YEAR, AVG(L_DISCOUNT) AS AVG_DISCOUNT FROM LINEITEM GROUP BY YEAR(L_SHIPDATE) ORDER BY SHIP_YEAR

question: Which five suppliers hold the most valuable inventory, measured as cost times available quantity? Return the supplier name and the total inventory value, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT S.S_NAME, SUM(PS.PS_SUPPLYCOST * PS.PS_AVAILQTY) AS TOTAL_VALUE FROM PARTSUPP PS JOIN SUPPLIER S ON PS.PS_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY GROUP BY S.S_SUPPKEY, S.S_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_VALUE DESC, S.S_SUPPKEY ASC LIMIT 5

question: How many urgent orders were placed each year? Return the year and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(O_ORDERDATE) AS ORDER_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS URGENT_COUNT FROM ORDERS WHERE O_ORDERPRIORITY = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY YEAR(O_ORDERDATE) ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR

question: How many line items belong to orders of each priority level? Return the priority level and the line-item count.
gold_sql: SELECT O.O_ORDERPRIORITY, COUNT(*) AS LINEITEM_COUNT FROM ORDERS O JOIN LINEITEM L ON O.O_ORDERKEY = L.L_ORDERKEY GROUP BY O.O_ORDERPRIORITY ORDER BY O.O_ORDERPRIORITY

question: How much revenue did customers in each nation generate? Return the nation name and the revenue, highest revenue first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME AS NATION, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC

question: Which five nations had the most returned items, counting by the customer's nation? Return the nation name and the return count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, COUNT(*) AS RETURN_COUNT FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY WHERE L.L_RETURNFLAG = 'R' GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY RETURN_COUNT DESC, N.N_NAME ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average order value for each world region? Return the region name and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, AVG(O.O_TOTALPRICE) AS AVG_ORDER_VALUE FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY R.R_NAME

question: How much revenue came from customers in the building segment, split by ship mode? Return the ship mode and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT L.L_SHIPMODE, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY WHERE C.C_MKTSEGMENT = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY L.L_SHIPMODE ORDER BY L.L_SHIPMODE

question: How many distinct parts are supplied by suppliers in each region? Return the region name and the distinct part count.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, COUNT(DISTINCT PS.PS_PARTKEY) AS DISTINCT_PARTS FROM PARTSUPP PS JOIN SUPPLIER S ON PS.PS_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY R.R_NAME

question: Which three nations earned the most revenue from urgent orders? Return the nation name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY WHERE O.O_ORDERPRIORITY = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC, N.N_NAME ASC LIMIT 3

question: How much revenue did each region generate from items shipped in 1996? Return the region name and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY WHERE YEAR(L.L_SHIPDATE) = 1996 GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY R.R_NAME

question: Which five nations have the highest average spending per customer? Return the nation name and the average, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, SUM(O.O_TOTALPRICE) / COUNT(DISTINCT C.C_CUSTKEY) AS AVG_SPENT_PER_CUSTOMER FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY AVG_SPENT_PER_CUSTOMER DESC, N.N_NAME ASC LIMIT 5

question: How many line items were shipped late, grouped by the supplier's nation? Return the nation name and the late-shipment count.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, COUNT(*) AS LATE_COUNT FROM LINEITEM L JOIN SUPPLIER S ON L.L_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY WHERE L.L_SHIPDATE > L.L_COMMITDATE GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY N.N_NAME

question: How much revenue did each manufacturer earn from European customers? Return the manufacturer and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT P.P_MFGR, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN PART P ON L.L_PARTKEY = P.P_PARTKEY JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY WHERE R.R_NAME = 'EUROPE' GROUP BY P.P_MFGR ORDER BY P.P_MFGR

question: Which five nations have suppliers holding the most valuable inventory? Return the nation name and the total inventory value, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, SUM(PS.PS_SUPPLYCOST * PS.PS_AVAILQTY) AS TOTAL_VALUE FROM PARTSUPP PS JOIN SUPPLIER S ON PS.PS_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_VALUE DESC, N.N_NAME ASC LIMIT 5

question: What share of total revenue does each region account for? Return the region name and the percentage.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) / (SELECT SUM(L2.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L2.L_DISCOUNT)) FROM LINEITEM L2), 2) AS REVENUE_PCT FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY R.R_NAME

question: How much did each nation's customers spend on urgent or high-priority orders? Return the nation name and the total spent.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, SUM(O.O_TOTALPRICE) AS TOTAL_SPENT FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY WHERE O.O_ORDERPRIORITY IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY N.N_NAME

question: How many orders were placed by customers in each region? Return the region name and the order count.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY R.R_NAME

question: Which three regions earn the most revenue from items shipped by air? Return the region name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY WHERE L.L_SHIPMODE = 'AIR' GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total revenue attributed to suppliers in each nation? Return the nation name and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN SUPPLIER S ON L.L_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY N.N_NAME

question: Which five parts generated the most revenue from Asian customers? Return the part name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT P.P_NAME, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) AS REVENUE FROM LINEITEM L JOIN PART P ON L.L_PARTKEY = P.P_PARTKEY JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY WHERE R.R_NAME = 'ASIA' GROUP BY P.P_PARTKEY, P.P_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC, P.P_PARTKEY ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average revenue per order for each customer nation? Return the nation name and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, SUM(L.L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L.L_DISCOUNT)) / COUNT(DISTINCT O.O_ORDERKEY) AS AVG_REVENUE_PER_ORDER FROM LINEITEM L JOIN ORDERS O ON L.L_ORDERKEY = O.O_ORDERKEY JOIN CUSTOMER C ON O.O_CUSTKEY = C.C_CUSTKEY JOIN NATION N ON C.C_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY N.N_NAME

question: Which five supplier nations have the most late shipments? Return the nation name and the late count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT N.N_NAME, COUNT(*) AS LATE_COUNT FROM LINEITEM L JOIN SUPPLIER S ON L.L_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY WHERE L.L_SHIPDATE > L.L_COMMITDATE GROUP BY N.N_NAME ORDER BY LATE_COUNT DESC, N.N_NAME ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average account balance of suppliers in each region? Return the region name and the average balance.
gold_sql: SELECT R.R_NAME AS REGION, AVG(S.S_ACCTBAL) AS AVG_BALANCE FROM SUPPLIER S JOIN NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY JOIN REGION R ON N.N_REGIONKEY = R.R_REGIONKEY GROUP BY R.R_NAME ORDER BY R.R_NAME
